name: reply-markdown
description: Draws a reply's headings, lists, quotes, callouts, tables and rules in color, and its code fences as cards with a copy button (terminal)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn this mod off without removing it. Takes effect at once.

tableBorder.title: Table border
tableBorder.description: The lines of a table's frame. round: thin lines, rounded corners. single: thin lines, square corners. bold: thick lines, square corners. Thick lines cannot have rounded corners: no such characters exist.

cardBorder.title: Card and callout border
cardBorder.description: The border of a code card and of a callout box. round: thin lines, rounded corners. single: thin lines, square corners. bold: thick lines, square corners.
